summary: Expanded the universe around politically sensitive state/local and federal modernization budgets. The cleanest reference exposure is Tyler Technologies for public-sector software and public-safety systems. The underfollowed lane is more interesting in niche law-enforcement digital forensics, public-sector cyber/IT distribution, biometric identity verification, and controversial but sticky local public-safety SaaS. Several names are below the preferred USD 300M threshold and should remain speculative exceptions until contract durability and procurement evidence are verified.
